Index.subtitle: Four directions for the new site. Explore each one and choose the one that best tells Forja's story.
Index.conceptA: Sober and direct. The work speaks. Built to launch fast and fly on mobile.
Index.conceptB: Bold and kinetic. 2026 trends: bento grid, kinetic type, living scroll.
Index.conceptC: Warm and cinematic. The language of a great animation studio, with soul.
